clue.text: Almost arhythmic songsters

indicators.note: almost means the word is cut short by its final letter

parts.note: music that is arhythmic has no beat, so it is beatless

explanation.surface: Some singers can barely keep time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Almost' cuts the last S from BEATLESS.
explanation.definitionFit: The Beatles were a famous group of singers, so they are songsters.

clue.text: Look into loan raised as a lump

indicators.note: raised in a down clue means the word is read upwards
into means one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a sub is an advance or loan on wages
lo is an old word meaning look

explanation.surface: Someone looks into a loan that has been raised as a lump sum.
explanation.walkthrough: LO goes into SUB to make SULOB, and 'raised' turns that whole word upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A bolus is a small round lump, especially of chewed food.

clue.text: Where to find flight controllers and graduates in a rage

indicators.note: in means the graduates sit inside the rage

parts.note: ire is rage
BAs are holders of a Bachelor of Arts degree

explanation.surface: Air traffic staff and graduates fly into a rage.
explanation.definitionFit: An airbase is a military airfield, where the people directing flights work.

clue.text: Part of ear revealed at topless ball

indicators.note: topless in a down clue means the first letter is removed

parts.note: a globe is a ball

explanation.surface: An earlobe is on show at a topless ball.
explanation.definitionFit: The lobe is the soft lower part of the outer ear.

clue.text: Upset UN's applecart: render "Help" (song by 1 across)

definitions.text: Upset UN's applecart: render "Help" (song by 1 across)

indicators.note: to upset something is to knock it over, so all these letters are thrown into a new order

parts.note: the letters of UN and its S are all used
the answer to 1 across is the ... name

explanation.surface: A protest that turns the United Nations upside down by covering a famous Beatles song.
explanation.walkthrough: A composite anagram of the whole clue, with 1 across supplied as BEATLES, gives the album title; the clue also defines it as the Beatles' title song.
explanation.definitionFit: The title track of the 1967 album is a song by the Beatles.

clue.text: Arrangement of Bach — one to live with

indicators.note: an arrangement of a piece rearranges it, so these letters are reordered

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A musician offers a version of Bach as a companion piece.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Arrangement of' shuffles BACH, I and TO; the musical sense of 'arrangement' hides the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: To cohabit is to share a home with a partner, to live with them.

clue.text: Fruit of aunt's toil after getting right into dance — well done!

indicators.note: after puts the rearranged letters behind the dance
into means the letter goes inside the dance

parts.note: the conga is a dance

indicators.note: the fruit of labour is what it produces, so these letters are worked into a new form

parts.note: the S of the possessive is used as a letter

explanation.surface: Congratulating an aunt whose hard work at the dance paid off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fruit of' looks like a reward for the aunt's labour, but it signals the anagram; 'well done!' is the exclamation the whole word stands for.
explanation.definitionFit: Well done! is an exclamation of praise, as is the word of good wishes.

clue.text: Wilful bird welcomes modern way to gain weight

indicators.note: welcomes means the bird takes the other pieces inside it

parts.note: a heron is a wading bird
AD, anno domini, the present era, so modern
ST is the abbreviation for street, a way
G is the abbreviation for gram, a weight

explanation.surface: A bird takes up a new method of putting on weight.
explanation.definitionFit: Headstrong means stubborn and self-willed, synonyms of wilful.

clue.text: It's not for sight-reading

parts.note: sight-reading suggests playing music at first look; read literally, this is a script read by touch rather than by eye

explanation.definitionFit: Braille is the raised-dot writing system read with the fingertips by blind people.

clue.text: Many in the inner circle quake

indicators.note: in means the letter goes inside the circle

parts.note: on a dartboard the treble is the narrow inner ring
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, so many

explanation.surface: Many in the elite circle shake with fear.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'inner circle' sounds like an elite group; it is the treble ring on a dartboard.
explanation.definitionFit: To tremble is to shake or quiver, as does a quake.

clue.text: Poet's sea bird circling road by right

indicators.note: circling means the bird goes round the other pieces

parts.note: a loon is a diving sea bird, the North American name for a diver

explanation.surface: A sea bird flies round a road on the right-hand side.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Poet's' reads as 'Poet is', so the definition is the poet himself.
explanation.definitionFit: Lord Byron was a leading English Romantic poet.

clue.text: Conscious of sun god recoiling in admiration

indicators.note: in means one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: awe is reverent admiration

indicators.note: recoiling suggests springing back, so the god's name is read backwards

parts.note: Ra is the Egyptian sun god

explanation.surface: Someone recoils before a sun god, filled with admiration.
explanation.definitionFit: To be aware of something is to know of it, to be conscious of it.

clue.text: Try to wound

definitions.meaning: to have a ... at something is to attempt it

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are standard: an attempt, and a thrust with a knife.

clue.text: See 4
Product of northern ranch — beef and vegetable

indicators.note: a product is what something is made into, so these letters are remade

explanation.surface: Beef and vegetables are produced on a northern ranch.
explanation.definitionFit: A French bean is a green bean, a common vegetable.

clue.text: Cell for nerve gas outside the old city

indicators.note: outside means the gas wraps round the city

parts.note: neon is a noble gas
Ur is the ancient Mesopotamian city, a crossword staple

explanation.surface: Gas is released beyond an ancient city's walls.
explanation.definitionFit: A neuron is a nerve cell, the unit that carries nerve signals.

clue.text: Earthy sea bird keeping soldiers to the point

indicators.note: keeping means the bird holds the soldiers inside

parts.note: a tern is a sea bird
RE, the Royal Engineers, are soldiers
E, east, is a compass point

explanation.surface: A sea bird holds back troops to make its point.
explanation.definitionFit: Terrene is a rare word for of the earth, earthly or earthy.

clue.text: Back legs deliver sharp blow to vegetable

indicators.note: back tells us to read the whole run of pieces from end to start

parts.note: pins is slang for legs
a rap is a sharp blow

explanation.surface: Someone's back legs deliver a sharp kick to a vegetable.
explanation.definitionFit: A parsnip is a pale root vegetable.

clue.text: Some Treasury papers brought up for writing on

indicators.note: brought up in a down clue means the letters are read upwards
some means only part of the words treasury papers is taken

explanation.surface: Some treasury documents are produced for the record.
explanation.definitionFit: Papyrus was the reed material ancient Egyptians made into sheets to write on.

clue.text: Author's cut by leading family

definitions.meaning: a writer's share of the proceeds from each sale
a ruling house, such as kings and queens

explanation.definitionFit: Royalty means both a payment to an author per copy sold and the members of a royal family.

clue.text: See 4
There's nothing in the Communist East like a cat

indicators.note: in means nothing is placed inside the name

parts.note: Lenin was the Russian Communist leader
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Communist countries in the East have nothing feline about them.
explanation.definitionFit: Leonine means lion-like, and the lion is a big cat.

clue.text: It's extremely silly to put axe in the way of a maniac

indicators.note: in means these pieces are placed inside the way

parts.note: a path is a way

indicators.note: extremely picks the outer letters of the word silly

parts.note: to axe is to chop

explanation.surface: Putting an axe in someone's path is a crazy idea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put' and 'It's' are only link words; the insertion splits the way after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A psychopath is a person with a severe personality disorder, loosely a dangerous madman.

clue.text: Piece of wood concealing origin of Norwegian pine

indicators.note: concealing means the wood hides the letter inside it

parts.note: a log is a piece of wood

indicators.note: origin of takes the first letter of the word Norwegian

explanation.surface: A log of Norwegian pine hides where it came from.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pine' looks like part of the timber story, but it is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To pine for something is to yearn or long for it.

clue.text: Welcome cry in the North

definitions.meaning: in Scots and northern English dialect to ... means to weep

explanation.definitionFit: Greet means to welcome, and in Scottish dialect also to cry or weep.

clue.text: See 4
About to receive sort of poet

indicators.note: to receive means the first word takes the other inside it

parts.note: re means about, concerning
ilk means sort or kind

explanation.surface: A certain kind of poet is about to be welcomed.
explanation.definitionFit: Rainer Maria Rilke was an Austrian poet.

clue.text: Calling up a vet with voice breaking

indicators.note: a breaking voice cracks, so the letters are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: A vet's voice breaks while he calls someone up.
explanation.definitionFit: Something evocative calls up memories or feelings, summoning them to mind.

clue.text: Gets limp Buddhist principle in Proverbs

indicators.note: in means the principle sits inside the other word

parts.note: something that sags droops or gets limp
yin is the passive principle of Chinese philosophy

explanation.surface: Wisdom literature about a principle that grows limp.
explanation.definitionFit: Proverbs are pithy sayings, wise maxims.

clue.text: Most blue seats left out by model

indicators.note: out means the letter for left is removed

parts.note: saddles are seats on a horse or bike
the Model T was Ford's famous car

explanation.surface: A model leaves out some seats, to everyone's dismay.
explanation.definitionFit: Blue means sad, so the most blue is the saddest.
